title: Kilbeggan Distillery
scope: The historic Kilbeggan Distillery north of Bridge Street, with its whitewashed slate-roofed courtyard ranges, brick chimney, millrace and restored waterwheel.
limitations: The mapped range boundaries and wheel centre follow native survey features. The internal courtyard footprint, individual roof divisions, chimney position and height, and façade bays are estimated.

The open elevation field describes the site and surrounding gradients at its available sampling resolution. Narrow race walls, water level and local retaining structures are approximate. The model represents the north-bank historic museum ranges, with exhibits and the far-side warehouse annexes outside its scope.
